reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E:09 as a heat-pump heating fault, asked sensible free checks, then gave a properly isolated (unplugged, water off) resistance test with interpretation, reached the confirmed open-circuit diagnosis matching the hidden truth, and offered a balanced repair-vs-replace analysis for a 9-year-old machine with the correct part (heat pump by E-Nr/FD). Conversation 1 reached the right general cause but stopped after one question, gave no cost figures despite the customer asking, offered no test to confirm heater vs wiring/NTC, and simply mandated an engineer without addressing the repair-vs-replace question. Conversation 2's only minor weakness is somewhat lengthy output and a 'control module' row in its cost table, but it never asserted the board was faulty and never recommended ordering before testing.
